title: Florida couple's $2.77 million custom home project never began; appeals court reverses $126,624 damages award
summary_full: A couple in Florida faced a reversal of a damages award related to their failed construction project. They had originally paid $257,500 towards a custom home that was never built. The appeals court decided that their claims should be resolved through arbitration, as stipulated in their construction agreement. Allegations of fraudulent misrepresentation against the construction company's owners were thus addressed in this ruling.
